normalization.title: Adjusted attendance
normalization.description: Logs are aggregated per person (email when available, otherwise Zoom user id or display name). Duplicate back-to-back events from Zoom are merged. If someone was already in the meeting before the portal could log a join, an estimated join may appear. Joins before the scheduled start time are labeled; minutes in the summary count from scheduled start through leave, or through the scheduled end if they stayed on.
